hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); r=0; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check --fix "$f" 1>&2 || r=2; pyright "$f" 1>&2 || r=2 ;; *.ipynb) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check --fix "$f" 1>&2 || r=2 ;; esac; exit $r
r=0; ruff check -q . 1>&2 || r=2; ruff format --check -q . 1>&2 || r=2; pytest -q 1>&2; c=$?; [ $c -ne 0 ] && [ $c -ne 5 ] && r=2; exit $r
